annotations.title: Search no-interview jobs and gig apps

description: Find US jobs and gig apps a person can start without a job interview, filtered by category, background check, vehicle, payout speed, minimum age and more. Returns requirements, pay terms and a link to the full sourced listing on clockintoday.com.

background_check.description: Whether the platform runs a criminal background check

category.description: drive = driving & delivery, shift = shift work, task = tasks & labor, care = pets & care, online = online & remote, cash = surveys & rewards, studies = plasma & medical studies

max_age.description: The person's age: only platforms whose published minimum age is at or below it

payout.description: 'fast' for instant, every-3-hours or next-day pay, or an exact label like 'Instant' or 'Weekly'

q.description: Free-text search across platform name and summary

vehicle.description: What the person has: none = only platforms needing no vehicle; bike = none or bike; car = anything but truck-only; truck = all

name: search_platforms
title: Search no-interview jobs and gig apps
